model.title: A resolution supporting the designation of the week of September 20 through September 26, 2026, as "Telehealth Awareness Week".

summary.text: The resolution would support designating a specific week in September 2026 as "Telehealth Awareness Week" to recognize and promote the importance of telehealth services in American healthcare.
